ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 90-95% low-intensity (dark) pixels and 5-10% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated at margins and specific focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity white blobs detected at: (1) distal tip of the left lobe; (2) vertical linear patch approximately 20% width-offset to the left of the median notch; (3) scattered micro-spots on the right lobe; (4) irregular mottling along the far-right lateral margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 60 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical pixel span of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical high-amplitude serrations. Left lobe trailing edge features 3-4 distinct jagged peaks. Right lobe trailing edge is characterized by a significant, large-scale rectangular indentation (step) near the notch, followed by smaller, irregular peaks towards the lateral tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a linear-to-slightly-convex sweep ending in an acute tip. Right lobe follows a broad, convex parabolic curve ending in a rounded lateral margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple roughly circular high-contrast clusters (<5px diameter) distributed across the lower-mid region of the right lobe and along the distal edge of the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of one prominent vertical white linear mark (rake mark) on the left lobe adjacent to the notch, and 2-3 shorter, parallel vertical marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss/traumatic indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, creating a distinct non-symmetrical 'stepped' geometric profile compared to the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white pigmentation localized strictly to the extreme trailing edge of the left lobe tip.
